item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-11-24
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the gap with Nvidia in the AI chip race
Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

2. [Tech News] Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

3. [Tech News] You won’t see a Galaxy Watch 10 until 2028 – here’s why
In an effort to cut costs, Samsung is postponing the launch of the Galaxy Watch 10, according to reports. Here’s what to know.

4. [Tech News] Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

5. [Tech News] Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.
